entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Portuguese explorers named the island 'Os Barbados' (The Bearded Ones) likely referencing the hanging aerial roots of bearded fig trees. Spain briefly claimed but never settled the island, and it remained essentially unoccupied.
